Glance 2026.08.06.3 moves PDF and archive support into isolated optional components.

## Highlights

- Install PDF preview as an optional component, with Office support depending on it automatically.
- Preview ZIP, 7z, RAR, tar, ISO, and other common archive formats without extracting the full archive first.
- Configure rich-document rendering from Document Preview when the PDF component is available.
- View file permission information correctly in the preview footer.

## Release contents

- `Glance-Setup-2026.08.06.3-x64.exe`: Recommended installer containing the core application and selectable optional components. All components are selected by default on a new installation.
- `Glance-2026.08.06.3-x64.zip`: Portable core application without optional components.
- `Glance-Component-<Name>-2026.08.06.3-x64.zip`: Standalone optional component. Use only the package from the same Glance release, extract it into the application's `components` directory, and restart Glance.
- `Glance-2026.08.06.3-x64-symbols.zip`: Debug symbols for diagnostics and crash analysis.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for every release asset.
